questionEn: How would you describe your body build and weight?
questionHi: आपकी शारीरिक बनावट और वजन कैसा है?

options.text: Thin, slender, bones prominent, difficult to gain weight
Medium build, athletic, moderate weight, easy to gain/lose
Heavy, broad frame, sturdy, gains weight easily, difficult to lose

questionEn: How does your skin feel normally?
questionHi: आपकी त्वचा सामान्यतः कैसी रहती है?

options.text: Dry, rough, thin, cracks easily, cool to touch
Warm, soft, prone to redness, moles/freckles, acne
Thick, smooth, oily, moist, radiant, cool

questionEn: How is your daily appetite and digestion?
questionHi: आपकी भूख और पाचन शक्ति (अग्नि) कैसी है?

options.text: Irregular (Vishama Agni) - sometimes very hungry, sometimes not, prone to bloating/gas
Intense & sharp (Tikshna Agni) - cannot skip meals, prone to acidity/heartburn
Slow but steady (Manda Agni) - can skip meals easily, feels heavy after eating

questionEn: How is your bowel movement regularity?
questionHi: आपका पेट साफ होने की प्रवृत्ति (कोष्ठ) कैसी है?

options.text: Hard, dry, irregular, prone to constipation (Krura Koshtha)
Soft, loose, frequent, easily stimulated by milk/fruits (Mridu Koshtha)
Moderate, regular, formed, slow (Madhyama Koshtha)

questionEn: How is your typical sleep quality?
questionHi: आपकी नींद का स्वरूप कैसा रहता है?

options.text: Light, interrupted, light sleeper, often restless (Alpa Nidra)
Moderate, sound, awakens easily if warm (Madhyama Nidra)
Deep, heavy, long hours, difficult to wake up in the morning (Gadha Nidra)

questionEn: Which weather is most uncomfortable for you?
questionHi: आपको किस प्रकार का मौसम सबसे अधिक कष्टदायक लगता है?

options.text: Dislikes cold, windy, dry weather; loves warmth and sun
Dislikes hot, humid weather; sweats profusely, prefers air conditioning
Dislikes cold, damp, rainy weather; comfortable in dry warmth

questionEn: How is your thinking, speaking, and emotional tendency?
questionHi: आपकी सोच, बोलने की गति और स्वभाव कैसा है?

options.text: Fast-talking, quick thinker, creative, gets anxious or worried easily
Sharp, precise, articulate, ambitious, gets irritated or angry quickly
Calm, patient, steady, speaks slowly and melodiously, forgiving

questionEn: How is your energy level and physical endurance?
questionHi: आपकी शारीरिक ऊर्जा और कार्य क्षमता (बल) कैसी है?

options.text: High bursts of energy but fatigues quickly, low stamina (Alpa Bala)
Moderate stamina, works intensely, gets exhausted in hot sun (Madhyama Bala)
Excellent endurance, high stamina, steady and long-lasting energy (Uttama Bala)
